headline: Kazakhstan's Oil Output Drops 6.8% and Gas Falls 9% in Jan-Oct 2026
summary: Kazakhstan's crude oil and condensate extraction dropped 6.8% year-on-year in the first ten months of 2026, while domestic natural gas output declined by 9%, official data showed.
why: Hydrocarbon extraction is the backbone of Kazakhstan's export revenues, state budget funding, and sovereign foreign exchange reserves.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Simultaneous drops in oil and natural gas production lower sovereign energy export volumes.
